description:
A REFERENCE instance of the SOURCE major on the SAME data, next to the target: `reference_db`
    is created from `source_copy_db` inside the Docker stack (add the source major to the stack
    first: docker_stack_init(versions=[<source>, <target>], ...) keeps existing confs), then
    `odoo neutralize` runs on it (nothing leaves the box) and report.url is set. Used by
    data_pump_parity to compare what real users see in the old and the new version. The source copy
    stays as it is (template copy). Without the filestore (parity reads metadata, not files).
name: data_pump_reference
